warning: This file exists because a direct comparison against official Indian government export statistics (APEDA, Tea Board) found the training panel systematically undercounts Gulf-state (Saudi Arabia, UAE, Iran, Iraq) trade volumes for at least basmati rice and black tea. These are targeted corrections for confirmed large gaps, not a comprehensive re-audit of all 33 catalogue products/53 countries.

facts.authority: APEDA (Agricultural and Processed Food Products Export Development Authority)
facts.source_document: APEDA basmati rice export statistics, reported via Indian trade press (FY2025-26 country-share projection)
facts.verification_note: Correction fact: the training panel (01_partner_discovery_india_as_exporter.parquet) records only ~$4.4M for SAU-IND basmati rice at the same period, ~33x below this officially-reported share-implied value. The panel systematically undercounts Gulf-state basmati demand (confirmed pattern, not isolated) — this verified figure should be preferred over the panel value for revealed-demand scoring on this corridor. estimated_export_value_usd is share_pct times the officially-reported FY2024-25 total (.94B), not a directly reported bilateral figure — treat as APEDA-share-derived, not a primary bilateral customs record.

facts.authority: APEDA (Agricultural and Processed Food Products Export Development Authority)
facts.source_document: APEDA basmati rice export statistics, reported via Indian trade press (FY2025-26 country-share projection)
facts.verification_note: India is reported to export ~1 million tonnes of basmati to Iran in FY2024-25, its 2nd-largest basmati market. Same undercounting pattern as Saudi Arabia applies here per the training panel.

facts.source_document: Tea Board of India provisional export statistics, reported via Indian trade/business press
facts.verification_note: Correction fact: UAE does not appear in the training panel's top-8 countries by export_value_usd for HS 090240 (black tea) at all, despite being the real #1 destination at 19.6% share (50.71M kg in 2025, up from 43.48M kg in 2024). Same Gulf-state undercounting pattern as basmati rice.
